text:
sofia: Morning async — quick check-in. What I did: landed kernel microbatch rewriter on canary, added slot packing, ran a dedupe perf sweep. Blockers: KV cache still thrashes under short sessions; eviction policy may be too aggressive. Today: triage eviction, follow up on CR #348, pair with @sam for canary plan.

sam: Nice. Can you drop the bench numbers when you have them?

sofia: Quick numbers (cold-mix run):
```
bench run --suite=dedupe --iter=100
p50: 12.0ms -> 10.8ms (-10%)
p95: 45.0ms -> 39.6ms (-12%)
tokens/s: 820 -> 920 (+12%)
```
warm-run p95 ~ 32ms. Cold starts still show more kv evict churn.

jordan: awesome win on p95. Were those runs with prefix caching enabled?

sofia: prefix + KV caching enabled, but the trace had lots of short-lived sessions which seems to blow the cache.

lee: Re: eviction — looked at slab allocator heuristics. We're tripping the watermark at ~70% for multi-tenant pools. For microburst workloads I'd try 80% and softer free-window. I can prototype a patch.

maria: FYI CR #348 (kernel: microbatch rewriter) needs one more review from @lee and a unit fix in kv_cache_test (flaky). I can take the test flake.

sam: I can review the CR this afternoon. For canary traffic, propose 10% -> 30% after 30m if signals look good. bench-bot, can you schedule the canary run?

bench-bot: scheduled canary perf run: 2024-07-10T15:00Z for 10% traffic slice. Monitoring hooks: /dash/kernels/traffic and /dash/kv/eviction.

sofia: Blocker: can't reproduce the eviction thrash locally with smaller traces. Requested full trace dump from infra for prod shard-7.

lee: I'll open a small patch to bump watermark and add debug logging (PR -> draft). Will tag @maria @sofia.

maria: taking kv_cache_test flake now. If I can't get a fix by EOD I'll revert allocator change on the canary.

sam: Heads up I'm OOO tomorrow morning; available after 1pm PT for pairing.

sofia: pairing with @sam at 1:30pm PT to finalize rollout and watch bench. I'll post the run output here after warm-run completes.

lee: LGTM to try the 80% watermark patch in a canary + bench loop once we have the trace. :thumbsup:

(bench-bot): perf queued: warm-run on canary; will post results to this thread when complete.
